mappings.rationale: Held-out run shows the regex failed with 'Regex input/pattern limit exceeded' on a long Suppliers cell (0 emissions, 1 error). The ABN-labelled extraction is still the only safe identifier path, so it is retained, but the pattern was not validated on held-out data. Confidence kept at 0.6 because no held-out ABN was successfully emitted and checksum validity is unverified. Requires a shorter-input or pre-split approach before reliance.

Buying agency unit; not supplier data.
Compound free text. Only the ABN-labelled identifier path is mapped; names, trading names, addresses, phones and emails cannot be safely attributed by index and remain unmapped.

warnings: Held-out validation emitted 0 observations and 1 error for Suppliers->entity.abn: regex input/pattern limit exceeded on a very long cell (Thomson Geer / UHY-style multi-party list). Zero emissions means no evidence the ABN path works on held-out data.
The ABN regex is anchored to the 'ABN:' label; rows without a labelled ABN produce no claims (most held-out sample rows have none).
Held-out sample rows show Suppliers lists with no ABN labels at all, so coverage of this mapping is expected to be very sparse.
observed_at_field is null; resource_last_modified_proxy is only a publication proxy, not a statement time.
No ACN mapped; no ACN inferred from ABN.
Buyer/agency fields (Department, Section, Contact*) must never be used as supplier identifiers.
Arrangement Number and Arrangement Name are not supplier identifiers or legal names.

changes.before: regex (?i)ABN:\s*(\d{11})\b group 1 all:true, then abn; separate_entities:true; confidence 0.6
changes.reason: No validated correction is available from the evidence. The held-out error is a regex input/pattern limit on an oversized cell, not a pattern or transform defect. The ABN-labelled extraction is still the only defensible identifier path. Changing the pattern without a successful held-out run would be unverified.

changes.field: Suppliers -> entity.legal_name / trading_name / address / phone / email
changes.reason: Compound multi-party free text with no safe per-party attribution by index. Remains unmapped.

changes.before: ABN checksum unverified; regex anchored to label
changes.after: Added held-out error and zero-emission finding
changes.reason: Held-out evidence shows the mapping produced no emissions and one regex limit error.

semantic_risks: Held-out run produced 0 ABN emissions and 1 regex input/pattern limit error, so the ABN path is not validated on held-out data.
Regex limit errors on long Suppliers cells mean some labelled ABNs in large lists may be silently dropped from coverage.
Held-out Suppliers samples contain no 'ABN:' labels, so coverage is expected to be very sparse.

Suppliers lists mix supplier names with buying-agency and note text (e.g. 'New SOA- Suppliers', '*Under negotiation'); any extracted ABN must be confirmed as a supplier identifier, not a buyer identifier.
Checksum validity is unverified (checksum_valid_abn=0 in training and held-out profiles).
observed_at is null and the only time is a publication proxy, so temporal claims are weak.
Supplier legal names and trading names remain unmapped; names such as 'Orion Laboratories T/A Perrigo...' show legal/trading ambiguity.
Source reliability 0.8 is an uncalibrated prior.
